shlodog.text: Logging in since 2013, ShloDog plays the long, unhurried game: never the fastest gun in the hex, never the easiest mark either, and square in the middle of the pack on nearly every count. The lifetime board sells them a little short, and while the headshots are rare, the results bend rather than break when the opponents get tougher. A steady regular, not a highlight reel.

sw1zzvs.text: SW1ZZVS does the quiet work that wins fights: upper tier in the matchups, steady when the opposition stiffens, and quick enough to keep the pressure on. The lifetime board undersells them a little, painting a middling picture where the matchups see a strong one. No single headline, just a player who turns up, holds their ground, and makes the other side work for everything.

sckj.text: SCKJ is still learning the ropes: below average in the matchups, slow on the trigger, and the aim is still finding itself. Yet the results land mid-pack, which says the instincts are already there. A regular who keeps showing up, and whose results already outrun the raw aim.

swzfh.text: Swzfh is early in the story: near the bottom on nearly every count, unhurried on the trigger, and still finding their feet when the opposition stiffens. That is not a verdict, just the first pages of a new regular learning the game one fight at a time.

schlumpfen.text: Schlumpfen fights like the textbook says to: upper tier on just about every count, quick off the mark, and still driving forward when the opposition gets serious. Lifetime board and matchups agree, which keeps the story clean. The opponent sample behind this one is older and smaller, so take it as a sketch.

saiinznc.text: SaiinZNC is a metronome: matchup rating and activity both among the top handful, with bravery keeping pace and a pace that never slackens. Accuracy near the top, headshot share to match, and the lifetime IvI sits at the very top too. A player who brings the same sharp game to every fight.

sarleyy.text: Sarleyy is a veteran still fighting near the very top: matchup rating near the top, activity alongside it, and resistance alongside the very best. Accuracy and headshot share both sit near the top, and the lifetime numbers keep pace with the matchups. A veteran who still brings the pace.

sgecsd.text: SGEcsd plays a patient, punishing game: matchup rating near the top, resistance up with the very best, and a matchup kill-death line sitting near the top. The accuracy and headshot share both sit in the middle, and the lifetime board paints a modest picture, with the lifetime IvI trailing far behind what the matchups support. The edge stands up against the hardest third too, which rounds out a card that undersells itself on the lifetime board.

simplenubbnc.text: SimplenubbNC arrived days ago and already fights at the very top: matchup rating, activity, and resistance all sitting with the very best, with a matchup kill-death line right there with it. The bravery number is low, which fits a player who picks the opening and then commits. Early read, but the opening pages already show the shape of things.

simplenubbtr.text: SimplenubbTR is barely days into the record and already fights near the very top: matchup rating near the top, activity among the very best, and a pace that never dips. The accuracy and headshot share both sit at the very top, and the lifetime IvI sits among the very best as well. Early read, yet the first pages already look the part.

sputniknc.text: SputniKNC plays a fast, fearless game: matchup rating among the very best, bravery near the top of the scale, and a tempo that never drops. The accuracy sits near the top, and the lifetime numbers agree with the matchups. A player who runs toward the hardest fights and usually wins them.

sputniktr.text: SputniKTR brings heat to every fight: matchup rating ranked among the very best, bravery sitting near the top, and a clip that never dips. The accuracy sits near the top, the headshot share too, and the lifetime board backs up the matchups. A player who hunts the hardest fights and usually comes out ahead.

sputnikvs.text: SputniKVS is a whirlwind: matchup rating sitting among the very best, bravery up near the top, and a cadence that never eases. The accuracy sits near the top, and the lifetime numbers back up the matchups. A player who chases the hardest fights and usually wins them.

safgsas.text: SAFGSAS plays a wild, devastating game: among the highest tracked in the matchups, a brisk tempo, and unmoved as fights harden. The aim wanders, the accuracy sits at the very bottom, yet the shots that connect tend to land in the head. Young account, early read, and the lifetime IvI line sits near the very bottom while the matchups say otherwise.

simplenubb.text: Simplenubb plays a steady, complete game: belongs with the best tracked on nearly every measure, a quick tempo, and unbending as the opposition strengthens. The pressure stays high as the opposition strengthens. Lifetime record matches the matchups, plain and simple. A steady regular, top to bottom.

selbstreflexion.text: Selbstreflexion plays a fast, front-foot game: among the most prolific finishers in the game, perched near the very top, and untiring through the toughest fights. The edge dips a little when the fight gets hardest, the lone wrinkle in an otherwise fierce card. Not yet a year in, already a fixture of the fight.

sreinvs.text: SreinVS fights at their own tempo: high on the board of everyone tracked, unwavering as the opposition improves. Steady against the hardest opposition, too. The pace is measured rather than frantic, yet the edge survives the hardest third too. A deliberate, dangerous regular who makes every shot count.

superassaultxaki.text: SuperAssaultxAki plays like a storm front: among the quickest finishers in the game, among the elite of everyone tracked, and fearless when the opposition sharpens. The accuracy sits near the top too, which fills out a complete card. Less than a year in, and already a name the fight bends around.

skrvs.text: Skrvs plays a clean, complete game: top shelf on the whole card, with a trigger that never cools and a bite that holds as the heat rises. Aim lands, headshots stack up, and the lifetime ledger backs up the matchups. No soft spot, just a strong game all the way through.

stoprunningmeoverpls.text: stoprunningmeoverpls is all precision and pressure: top shelf on the full ledger, a trigger that never rests, and a bite that swells as the pressure rises. The aim lands true, headshots keep piling up, and the kept share stays strong against the strongest third. No soft spot anywhere, just a strong game from first to last.

sunolddogg.text: SunOldDogG brings the pace: top shelf across the ledger, with a trigger that stays lit and a game that holds as the stakes rise. Aim lands, the volume stays high, and the lifetime tally matches the matchups. A strong regular, full stop, end of story.

supersoldierxaki.text: SuperSoldierxAki goes looking for the fight: the output sits top shelf, and it grows as the heat rises. The trigger stays hot, the aim lands true, and headshots keep piling up. The career numbers line up with the matchups — a strong regular, no doubt at all.

svip00465.text: SVIP00465 arrived yesterday and already fights like a headline: among the elite for raw output, with the sharpest aim anywhere on the board and a pace that never lets up. The resistance holds against strong opposition, though the share kept against the strongest third slips. Young account, early read — but the opening pages are loud.

s00ndreetr.text: S00NDREETR leaves very little on the table: top-flight in the matchups, a firing pace among the very fastest, and headshots landing among the very best tracked. The brave line sits at the very top, and the edge holds up well against the strongest third. Lifetime numbers match the matchups, a complete card by any measure.

softcoretr.text: Since 2015, softcoreTR has played a quiet, top-shelf game: solid in the matchups, steady when facing harder foes, and precision up near the summit. Mid-pack consistency is the one blemish on a card that is otherwise upper-tier. The two boards agree, and the story needs no footnotes.

schlumpfenvs.text: SchlumpfenVS is a young account already playing like a fixture: elite on every line, with a relentless output and a game that keeps winning as the enemies get tougher. The consistency mark sits near the top too, so the results survive the strongest third. Early read, but the start already speaks volumes.

standstilllcantaim.text: StandStilllCantAim plays a polished, high-volume game: aim at the very top of the tracked population, a high headshot share, and a work rate that never lets up. Top-shelf rating, and the lifetime IvI lands among the best, a touch above the matchups. A complete player, no soft spot anywhere, and the whole card reads strong.

skinnycaramelcoffee.text: SkinnyCaramelCoffee wins fights with volume and precision: top shelf in the matchups, with accuracy near the very top. The shots land low, though, and headshots are rare, while the lifetime IvI line sits mid-table as the matchups say top. Against the hardest third, the grip loosens noticeably.

sooga.text: sooga is a young account with an old hand's touch: top shelf across the board, and accuracy at the very top. The headshot rate stays low, and the lifetime IvI figure sits mid-table, well below what the matchups suggest. Early read, but the opening pages are hard to ignore.

saltobutnowfornc.text: SaltoButNowForNC is a complete fighter: rating, activity, bravery, resistance, and matchup kill-death all near the very top, with a brisk kill pace and precise aim to match. The headshot share lands near the top and the lifetime board agrees. Take this one as a sketch rather than a finished portrait — the opponent sample behind it is older and smaller, though the card reads strong.

stillbreathing.text: StillBreathing plays a fast, fearless game: bravery and tempo both near the very top; resistance trails just behind, and a matchup mark right there too. The aim is precise, headshots land true and often, with the lifetime board putting them among the best tracked. Consistency fades against the hardest opposition, the single soft line on an otherwise top-shelf sheet.

silkoshvs.text: SilkoshVS plays at full throttle: rating, activity, bravery, resistance, pace — everything near the very top. The aim is sharp, headshots land at a strong rate, and the lifetime board sits at the very best tracked, with the matchup kill-death figure a notch below the rest. The edge falls away against the strongest third.

staz6.text: Staz6 plays a polished, high-volume game: the adjusted lines all crowd the summit, the matchup kill-death figure standing alongside. Pace stays strong, the aim is keen, and headshots take a solid share of the shots. The lifetime board agrees, and the edge holds steady against the strongest third too.

sunolddogd.text: SunOldDogD arrived in 2026 and already plays like a fixture: every adjusted line crowds the very top. Pace sits near the top too, with sharp aim and a strong headshot share. The matchup kill-death mark lands a notch below the rest, and the edge fades a touch against the strongest third, but the card reads strong nearly everywhere.

sunolddogk.text: SunOldDogK is a young account already playing like a fixture: bravery among the very best tracked, with top-rank activity, resistance, and matchup rating. The aim lands true, with frequent headshots, and the lifetime numbers point the same way. Early read, but the first pages already carry weight — the strongest third sees consistency land mid-pack.

semiconductornc.text: SemiconductorNC runs hot and steady: pace at the top, bravery that strengthens as the enemies get tougher, and a matchup rating near the top. Consistency runs above average, so the edge holds against the strongest third. Accuracy and headshots both land above average, rounding out a card with no weak corner. A reliable, high-output fighter who shows up the same way every time.

stepmotherofpixelism.text: StepmotherOfPixelism brings order to chaos: a matchup rating sitting in the top shelf, bravery that climbs with the opposition, plus accuracy near the summit. The consistency mark sits above average too, so the results survive the strongest third. A veteran since 2015, still dictating the terms of every fight.

stryderas.text: Stryderas has been at this since 2015, and it shows: a mark in the top shelf, with a steady work rate, plus a game that meets tougher enemies head-on. The aim is precise, with headshots making up a strong share of the attempts. The lifetime board tells the same story as the matchups.

supernsobotxaki.text: SuperNsoBotxAki has been around barely a week, and the early read is electric: tempo and matchup kill-death mark both sit among the very best tracked, with rating, resistance, and aim right behind in the upper tier. Bravery is only middling, and consistency sits near the bottom — the game has not yet been tested against the hardest stretch. Still, a debut like this turns heads.

scytheinthearea.text: ScytheInTheArea reads the fight a beat early: the matchup rating stands near the top, the tempo runs there too, and the game stays sharp against tougher enemies. A kill-death mark sits up there too. The pace runs above average, accuracy holds the middle, and headshots sit well above average. Lifetime numbers land in the same strong range, closing out a card with no soft spots.

stevewolf.text: SteveWolf plays a waiting game with a devastating payoff: the matchup grade lands near the summit while the kill-death mark and resistance rank among the very best tracked. Bravery sits near the bottom, so they choose their moments and strike where the odds already favor them, letting the pace stay middling and the lifetime board sit far below the matchups. A veteran since 2012, still picking fights with cold precision.

saarrakvs.text: SaarrakVS plays like a wildfire: one of the busiest kill paces tracked, a game that rises as the opposition improves, and accuracy sitting at the very summit. The matchup grade stands near the top; lifetime board paints the same picture. Resistance sits above average, the single line that does not quite match the rest.

sogekingop.text: SogekingOP is a storm that never spends itself: work rate near the top, while a game that rises with the opposition, and a matchup rating in the same company. The headshot share runs near the top; lifetime board gives an identical story. Accuracy sits a notch below the rest of an otherwise strong card, yet the results never seem to notice.

superpifff.text: Superpifff has been around since 2012, and the card still crackles: matchup rating near the top. The game only improves as the opposition hardens, and a lifetime kill-death mark to match. Accuracy and headshots both sit above average, and the lifetime board lands a step below the matchups. A veteran account with a game that never went stale.
